title: Receptionist (Bank)
description: This is an exciting opportunity to work as a receptionist at a GP practice covering sessions for scheduled holidays, sickness and other adhoc requests. The purpose of the role is to: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate appointments, service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Offer general assistance to the Practice and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies We are looking for a positive and enthusiastic receptionist to join our established and hard working team. The role requires someone who is diligent, friendly and capable, someone who is self motivated, a good communicator and always striving for the best for the patients. Ideally the candidate will have experience of working in a reception environment within a healthcare setting but this is not essential as on-the-job training will be provided. Exceptional candidates without healthcare experience but with a strong and relevant background will also be considered. JOB TITLE: Receptionist REPORTS TO: Practice Manager HOURS: Morning sessions run from 07:45am until 12:45pm and afternoon sessions run from 13:45pm until 18:45pm. Job Summary: Offer general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice including the provision of clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the Practice team Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the Practice reception team are defined in the job description and may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Practice Manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels.

title: Administrator
description: Are you ready to play a vital role in transforming healthcare delivery? We're seeking a proactive and detail-driven MSK Health Administrator to support our Musculoskeletal Rehab (MSK) team. This is your chance to step into a dynamic environment where your coordination skills, initiative, and commitment to service excellence will help improve the lives of patients every day. We are looking for a reliable, enthusiastic, and organised individual who takes pride in delivering excellent administrative support. You will have a keen eye for detail, strong interpersonal skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. If you are passionate about helping others, have strong communication skills, and are looking to develop your career within the NHS, we would love to hear from you. This role is based at Brighton General Hospital with travel to Princess Royal Hospital and Hove Poly Clinic as required to cover admin annual leave and admin sickness. Please note: Due to recent changes in UK immigration and visa rules, this role may not be eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship. Applicants who do not currently have the right to work in the UK may not be considered. Please review the eligibility criteria on the gov.uk website before applying to assess their eligibility for a Certificate of Sponsorship for this role. Skilled Worker visa: going rates for eligible occupation codes - GOV.UK Health and Care Worker visa: If you'll need to meet different salary requirements - GOV.UK a) Ensure accurate data input using patient administration systems such as SystmOne. b) Provide high-quality reception duties, greeting and booking in patients attending MSK and Pelvic Health clinics. c) Work closely with the MSK team to ensure all documentation and correspondence are processed accurately and promptly. d) Monitor and action incoming referrals and triage outcomes, escalating issues when necessary. e) Support service audits, data collection, and performance reporting as required. f) Uphold NHS values, promoting dignity, respect, and compassionate care in all interactions. a. Book, amend and cancel patient appointments using the computer-based booking system (SystmOne) and the telephone call handling system(Cisco Jabber). b. Arrange cover for clinics within the constraints notified by the Admin Lead. c. Conversion of appointment slots under the direction of the Admin Lead. d. Monitor waiting lists and book patients in according to longest wait. e. Contribute to reducing the number of long waiters the service has. f. Maintaining stock levels and ordering stock across all services, clinical and non-clinical. g. To help cover other admin sites when there is the need. h. Check new referral details for completeness and accuracy using the NHS number and update and amend patient details as necessary. i. Compare new referral details with any existing registration details to ensure accuracy and avoid duplication. Accurately input patient referral details on to the Trust computer system. j. Take responsibility for liaising with professional colleagues to avoid unnecessary delays in the referral process. k. Communicate clearly and effectively with other professionals, outside agencies and patients. l. Ensure patient information remains confidential and that patient records are secure to assure confidentiality. m. Use the telephone or written media to make or amend patient appointments and deal with enquiries from patients or staff. n. To carry out other duties which fall within the remit of this post as required by the Lead Administrator. o. To contribute to the development of the admin service.

title: Reception Administrator
description: We are a large NHS Mental Health Trust in South East England. We're looking for people to help us provide high quality services for the patients, carers and local communities we serve. We want patients and staff to recommend our organisation as a place where they would be happy for their friends and family to be treated. You can help us do this by bringing your skills, experience and commitment to Sussex Partnership. We are looking for an enthusiastic, self-motivated and experienced part time receptionist. You will be based to work at Hove Polyclinic, First floor on the Millview Hospital site in Nevill Avenue, Hove. The post holder will look forward to a varied and rewarding work environment, in which finding a balance between team working and utilising initiative is important. You will need the ability to foster positive working relationships & in return be an essential part of the team. The post holder will be motivated and able to organise their workload, demonstrate a professional face to face and telephone manner, and be able to liaise effectively with other agencies and members of the public. The successful candidate will provide reception duties (checking in clients, taking in deliveries, liaising with team staff, booking rooms, taking calls etc) and general office tasks to support the admin team. An ability to deal sensitively with people who may be distressed at times is also essential. To deal with all incoming telephone calls and sign post as required To ensure post both internal and external is sent to the correct staff/team To be responsible for locking up at the end of the day To deal with all room booking requests via a generic inbox and booking resource scheduler system To support the wider team with duties such as Uploading Calling service users to advise prescriptions are ready for collection Photocopying see job description for further information
